what.text: This page follows people displaced inside Malawi, as recorded by IDMC.
At the end of 2024, IDMC counted 881 people displaced by conflict and violence.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict for Malawi, so it does not say why people were displaced by violence.
IDMC's disaster records for Malawi list floods and storms.

when.text: In 2024, the main year of displacement in the data, IDMC recorded 2377 new displacements by conflict and violence.

how.text: In 2025, IDMC recorded 46437 new displacements by disasters, also counting movements, not people.
The sources don't say where people went inside Malawi.
